content:
tanvi: FYI — field auditor asked for a replayable artifact that proves an RBAC change + KMS ephemeral key usage for the inference-annotator service. They want mapping to SOC2/ISO controls and chain-of-custody. Change window: 2025-10-14 14:00–14:20 UTC. Need: (1) k8s audit + rolebinding snapshot, (2) KMS encrypt/decrypt logs with CMK id, (3) signed manifest (ops PGP), (4) vuln-triage notes & incident linkage. Can folks assemble?

kai: I can grab k8s audit logs and IAM change history. Which cluster & exact timeframe?

tanvi: prod-infer-us-west2, window above. Also need cloud-kms project logs (keyring/key usage) and any HSM attestations for key wrapping. Auditor specifically asked for a notarized manifest + key usage timeline.

matt: there's an ops playbook at /playbooks/compliance/rbac-keyflow.md that outlines evidence export. Quick export command I use: 
```
./tools/export_proof.sh \ 
  --cluster prod-infer-us-west2 \ 
  --start 2025-10-14T13:58:00Z \ 
  --end   2025-10-14T14:25:00Z \ 
  --out   s3://redwood-compliance/proofs/1755552468/
```
It bundles k8s audit, controller-manager logs, and KMS CloudAudit logs. It also zips the PGP-signed manifest if you pass --sign.

deploy-bot: [deploy] infra/rbac:rolebinding/inference-annotator applied by tanvi @ 2025-10-14T14:03:12Z :white_check_mark:

auditor_lee: Quick Q — will an HSM vendor attestation + our signed manifest be acceptable, or do you need breaker-level key provenance from the HSM? Also, is the CMK a customer-managed key (CMK) or an envelope key under the vendor?

tanvi: Auditor: CMK is customer-managed in cloud-kms with HSM-backed key material (vendor attestation present). We have an HSM attestation PDF and a signed manifest (ops-pgp). We can also provide the KMS key metadata export (key version IDs, creation and rotation events).

kai: I'll run matt's script and then pull specific lines from audit logs for the window. Example excerpt I'll include in the bundle (sanitized):
```
2025-10-14T14:03:12Z audit: RoleBinding modification: cluster=prod-infer-us-west2 namespace=inference user=tanvi target=system:serviceaccount:inference:inference-annotator before=role-viewer after=role-writer
2025-10-14T14:03:13Z iam: serviceAccountKey created: name=projects/cloud-kms/cryptoKeys/ck-annotator/cryptoKeyVersions/3
2025-10-14T14:03:14Z kms: Encrypt invoked: key=ck-annotator/v3 caller=service-account:inference-annotator
2025-10-14T14:03:15Z kms: Decrypt invoked: key=ck-annotator/v3 caller=ops-rotation
```

auditor_lee: For vulnerability triage: was this RBAC change tied to an incident or CVE remediation? We need a triage note and owner. Also need the reasoning for granting writer-level to inference-annotator.

tanvi: Short answer: not for a CVE. It was an operational change to enable ephemeral caching writes after an infra migration; tracked in PR #4521. Owner: @tanvi, triage doc: https://redwood.internal/triage/4521. Summary: low-risk config change, tested in staging, no secrets exfil detected. I'll include triage notes and PR diff in the bundle.

kai: I'll export everything to s3://redwood-compliance/proofs/1755552468/ and set ACL to compliance-only. Once done I'll paste a manifest list and sha256 sums. Expected ETA ~ 30–40m.

matt: I'll attach the ops-PGP signature to the manifest and upload the HSM attestation PDF to the same bucket. Reminder: for ISO mapping, include control refs: A.9.2 (user access provisioning), A.9.4 (system access revocation), and Annex A evidence mapping in the README.

auditor_lee: Sounds good — please ping here when uploaded. We'll verify the signed manifest + log extracts and ask followups if we need deeper key provenance.

tanvi: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll wait for the S3 links and then prepare the crosswalk doc to SOC2 CC6.1/ISO mapping.

kai: upload done -> s3://redwood-compliance/proofs/1755552468/manifest.tar.gz (will paste object metadata & sha256 in thread when available).

tanvi: great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
